verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a first-party MCP server that brings Statsig into Codex, Cursor and Claude Code, and says you can "talk to your Statsig projects from within ChatGPT." That is a real, product-owned route to natural-language operation. However, it depends on an external AI client, and the evidence does not say which console actions can be performed this way. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, documentation of which create/update operations work via natural language versus read-only queries, and independent hands-on corroboration.
